title: Giraffe with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="42" y="30" width="16" height="42" rx="6" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <!-- Neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="38" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="48" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="58" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="24" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#F0B94A"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="14" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#F0B94A" transform="rotate(-30 32 14)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="14" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#F0B94A" transform="rotate(30 68 14)"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="14" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#D4872A" transform="rotate(-30 32 14)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="14" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#D4872A" transform="rotate(30 68 14)"/>
  <!-- Ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x="41" y="6" width="4" height="9" rx="2" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <rect x="55" y="6" width="4" height="9" rx="2" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="6" r="3.5" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="6" r="3.5" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="11" ry="7" fill="#F5D48A"/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="33" r="1.5" fill="#C98B2E"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="33" r="1.5" fill="#C98B2E"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M45 36 Q50 39 55 36" stroke="#C98B2E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="22" r="5" fill="#2C1B4D"/>
  <!-- Left eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="20" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="24" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="19.5" r="0.8" fill="#FFFDE0"/>
  <circle cx="38.5" cy="24" r="0.6" fill="#FFFDE0"/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx="59" cy="22" r="5" fill="#2C1B4D"/>
  <!-- Right eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="57.5" cy="20" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="24" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="19.5" r="0.8" fill="#FFFDE0"/>
  <circle cx="56.5" cy="24" r="0.6" fill="#FFFDE0"/>
  <!-- Extra tiny sparkle stars -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="17" r="1" fill="#FFE87C"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="17" r="1" fill="#FFE87C"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="25" r="0.7" fill="#FFE87C"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="25" r="0.7" fill="#FFE87C"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#F0B94A"/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="74" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="80" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="73" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="84" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="88" width="7" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <rect x="42" y="90" width="7" height="8" rx="2.5" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <rect x="54" y="90" width="7" height="8" rx="2.5" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <rect x="64" y="88" width="7" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#E8A73A"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="30" y="95" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#8B5A14"/>
  <rect x="42" y="95" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8B5A14"/>
  <rect x="54" y="95" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8B5A14"/>
  <rect x="64" y="95" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#8B5A14"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M76 80 Q83 76 82 68" stroke="#E8A73A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="67" r="3" fill="#B5701A"/>
  <!-- Little blush -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="27" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#F28B8B" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="27" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#F28B8B" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
